boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Gannon University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food runs anchored by Gannon’s own late counter and Erie restaurants with directly verified late hours. Check holiday and academic-break schedules before leaving.

cards.title: Stay on Campus at Doc’s Landing
cards.subtitle: Waldron Campus Center counter serving until midnight on several nights
cards.notes: Use mobile ordering when available, and confirm the academic calendar before relying on midnight service during breaks or holidays.
cards.short_summary: Gannon’s on-campus option pairs broad counter-service choices with documented midnight hours five nights each week.
cards.evidence_claim: Gannon’s 2025 meal-plan guide identifies Doc’s Landing in the Waldron Campus Center and lists service until midnight Tuesday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Monday 7:15 a.m.–10 p.m.; Tuesday–Friday 7:15 a.m.–midnight; Saturday 4 p.m.–midnight; Sunday 10 a.m.–10 p.m. Academic-break hours may differ.

cards.title: Use the Sassafras Street All-Nighter
cards.subtitle: A downtown counter and 24-hour drive-through south of Gannon
cards.notes: Check the lobby schedule before walking over; after-hours service can shift to the drive-through even when ordering remains available.
cards.short_summary: This nearby McDonald’s separates late lobby access from a drive-through that the location page lists around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s identifies its restaurant at 1115 Sassafras Street and lists late lobby hours plus a drive-through open 24 hours daily.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Erie, PA at 1115 Sassafras St | McDonald’s
cards.access_notes: Lobby closes at 3 a.m. Monday, Tuesday and Sunday, 4 a.m. Wednesday, and is listed 24 hours Thursday–Saturday. Drive-through is listed 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Head to Wendy’s Before 3
cards.subtitle: A downtown dining room and drive-through with the same late schedule
cards.notes: Aim for this address when the group needs indoor ordering late; verify holiday hours before leaving because the official page flags changes.
cards.short_summary: The East 12th Street Wendy’s documents a consistent 3 a.m. close for both restaurant and drive-through service.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists its 105 East 12th Street restaurant and drive-through as open from 6:30 a.m. until 3 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Wendy’s at 105 E. 12th St. in Erie, PA
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through hours are listed as 6:30 a.m.–3 a.m. Monday through Sunday. The location warns that holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Take the East 12th Street Taco Run
cards.subtitle: A downtown drive-through serving well beyond midnight
cards.notes: Plan transportation before choosing the post-midnight window: the official page documents extended drive-through hours, not matching late dine-in access.
cards.short_summary: This East 12th Street Taco Bell supplies one of downtown Erie’s latest directly documented food-service windows.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell identifies its restaurant at 118 East 12th Street and lists drive-through service until 5 a.m. most days and 5:30 a.m. Friday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Erie, PA — 118 E 12th St
cards.access_notes: Drive-through closes at 5 a.m. Sunday–Thursday, 5:30 a.m. Friday, and is effectively continuous Saturday. Dine-in access is not documented for the same full span.

cards.title: Order from West 14th Street
cards.subtitle: A downtown pizza carryout and delivery point near Gannon
cards.notes: Open the official store page immediately before ordering; its live status supplies the current closing time and the available fulfillment methods.
cards.short_summary: The closest named Domino’s to campus offers a directly documented downtown address, online ordering, carryout and delivery.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s identifies its Erie store at 51 West 14th Street, provides online ordering and describes the location as offering takeout and delivery with live store hours.
cards.source_title: Domino’s Pizza at 51 W 14th St | Domino’s in Erie
cards.access_notes: The official page publishes a live open/closed status and current closing time rather than a static weekly table; check it before departure because hours vary by day.

cards.title: Make the Peach Street 1 A.M. Run
cards.subtitle: A longer southbound drive with nightly late service
cards.notes: Treat this as a vehicle trip rather than a campus walk, and use the official location page to recheck service before committing to the drive.
cards.short_summary: The Peach Street Wendy’s extends the board beyond downtown with a uniform, officially posted 1 a.m. schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists both restaurant and drive-through service at 5901 Peach Street from 10 a.m. until 1 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Wendy’s at 5901 Peach Street in Erie, PA
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through are listed as open 10 a.m.–1 a.m. Monday through Sunday. This destination requires a substantial trip south from campus.

cards.title: Push the Peach Street Run Later
cards.subtitle: Extended drive-through service with a 24-hour Saturday listing
cards.notes: Bring a designated driver and confirm dine-in status separately; the unusually late official schedule is specifically for the drive-through lane.
cards.short_summary: This Peach Street Taco Bell documents service to 4 or 5 a.m., with continuous Saturday drive-through operation.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell identifies its 4305 Peach Street location and lists drive-through hours until 4 a.m. or 5 a.m., plus 24-hour Saturday service.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Erie, PA — 4305 Peach Street
cards.access_notes: Drive-through closes at 4 a.m. Monday–Wednesday and Sunday, 5 a.m. Thursday–Friday, and is listed open 24 hours Saturday. Verify dine-in separately.

cards.title: Use East 38th for a 4 A.M. Option
cards.subtitle: An east-side restaurant with uniform late hours
cards.notes: Choose this location only when the east-side drive makes sense, and confirm the official hours before setting out from downtown Erie.
cards.short_summary: The East 38th Street location stands out for publishing the same 4 a.m. closing time across the entire week.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell identifies its restaurant at 2007 East 38th Street and lists both drive-through and dine-in hours through 4 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Dinner Near Me — 2007 E 38th Street, Erie
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists 9 a.m.–4 a.m. Monday through Sunday for the drive-through and displays the same span for dine-in service.

cards.title: Pair Perry Highway with a 3 A.M. Stop
cards.subtitle: A far-south Erie drive-through near the interstate
cards.notes: Reserve this for trips already heading toward the interstate; it is far from campus, so verify hours and transportation before departure.
cards.short_summary: The Perry Highway Taco Bell offers a predictable 3 a.m. endpoint for late drives on Erie’s southern edge.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell identifies its restaurant at 8056 Perry Highway and lists drive-through service from 9 a.m. until 3 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurant Near Me — 8056 Perry Highway, Erie
cards.access_notes: Drive-through hours are listed as 9 a.m.–3 a.m. Monday through Sunday. This is a vehicle-oriented destination well south of Gannon’s downtown campus.

cards.title: Use the 24-Hour Perry Highway Counter
cards.subtitle: A round-the-clock sandwich shop inside Pilot Travel Center #311
cards.notes: Combine this stop with an interstate-area trip rather than a special campus walk; confirm any holiday or maintenance disruption before leaving.
cards.short_summary: This Pilot Travel Center Subway supplies a documented 24-hour food counter when most conventional dining rooms are closed.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway identifies its shop inside Pilot Travel Center #311 at 8035 Perry Highway and lists store hours as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: Subway at 8035 Perry Hwy, Erie, PA
cards.access_notes: The official Subway location page lists the store as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday. It is a substantial drive south from Gannon’s campus.

warnings: Late-night access is frequently limited to drive-through service; cards distinguish that constraint where the official source does.
Academic breaks, holidays and live store conditions may alter posted hours, so users should recheck the linked direct source before departure.
